how: DEV only (818 images, 24 house families + the eight regression houses), grouped 5-fold CV by family, multinomial logistic regression on standardised features, class_weight=balanced; research/analyzer-source-01/study.py (torch/timm preprocessing, research only)

candidates.what: 24 hand-made pixel features (colour, white/dark share, hue bands, sky/ground bands, edge orientation, red ink)

candidates.params: 2.49 M trunk, ONNX fp32 9.9 MB, ops Conv/Relu/Add/GlobalAveragePool

candidates.why: licence not shippable in the app without an OWNER/legal decision
classification already separates the six kinds on held-out houses; free text is not the goal; size and runtime on the phone out of proportion

choice: MobileNetV4-conv-small: one error more than MobileNetV3-large on DEV but 60 % of its size, a plain op set, and no interior/exterior confusion; then re-measured on the PRODUCTION path (TypeScript decode + area resampling + ONNX Runtime Web): 0 errors in grouped CV (head-cv-dev.json) and 0 of 270 on the ten TEST houses
